title: Time account
sub: Target hours, worked hours and your running balance, month by month.
credits: + {t} credited for public holidays and absences
adjust_for: Adjustment for {name}. They will be notified.
entitlement_help: Leave empty to keep the default.
explain: How it works: every working day has a target from your work schedule. Public holidays and approved absences such as vacation or sickness are credited, so they don't create a deficit. Time worked beyond the target increases your balance; time off in lieu uses it up.
